name: run3_gate
hypothesis: Run 3 (8 min fine-tune of run 2, lr 1e-4): the alpha gate |delta| <= 0.5 x alpha is now part of the model (ScreenNetConfig.alpha_gate), so training sees what the runtime does. Run 2 passes every dataset gate but live 1440p frames show dark/purple halos on thin smoke edges; the post-hoc gate removed them. Same losses, hold-out selection (12 train scenarios), wd 0.05. Expect test still beating both baselines (maybe slightly smaller l1/ms_dssim gain), OOD-relative gate <= 1.2, no edge halos live.
